## About

I am a Senior Researcher at the Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), and an Assistant Professor at Leiden University Medical Center in the Netherlands and Nagasaki University in Japan.

My research bridges epidemic theory, data, and public health response to support decision-making under uncertainty in infectious disease control.
